summary: Iteration 6 (expo-router refactor) fully verified. Backend 15/15 pytest passed: email login, wrong-password 401, invalid Google session_id 401, /api/eat-now shape+calorie math, /api/coach/vision structured nutrition with model field (Groq key has no vision models -> Emergent fallback openai/gpt-5.4-mini, by design), reminders GET/PUT persistence, health/sync idempotency (second identical record upserted=0), and plan/dashboard/progress/meals/coach regression. Frontend web 390x844: login lands on Today with 4 tabs; eat-now modal + Log this round-trip; Plan 7 day-chips + log buttons; Coach chat reply; camera button -> /log-food -> web gallery picker -> vision confirm -> logged + returned; Progress chart + weight log; Settings toggles + Telugu switch (no layout overflow) + sign out to welcome. Google button initiates handoff to auth.emergentagent.com -> accounts.google.com without crashing (real OAuth cannot complete in automation, expected). Zero duplicate-key console warnings.

minor.issue: JWT_SECRET and GOOGLE_AUTH_HANDOFF_URL have hardcoded fallback defaults (env values are set, so no runtime impact; violates fail-fast config principle)

issues: cardEyebrow uses brandSecondary #8B6F47 on readinessCard background brandPrimary #4A6B5D — 'YOUR READINESS TODAY' / 'ENERGY BALANCE' labels are barely readable (~1.5:1 contrast). Reference: src/styles.ts:65-66
Coach reply bubble renders raw markdown (**, table pipes |) as plain text instead of formatted output — looks broken when Groq returns markdown tables

Telugu conjunct clusters render with dotted-circle shaping artifacts on web preview (e.g. header 'గోప్యత & సెట్టింగ్స్', 'రిమైండర్లు') — likely missing Telugu-capable font (e.g. Noto Sans Telugu) in web bundle; no overflow/clipping otherwise

react_native_issues.issue: No deprecated packages found (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch). expo-notifications web no-op is intentional by design. Reference: /app/frontend/package.json
